submittedPrompt: 制作一张清晰三分区对照板，外部只标桌面、390px、320px，表示三个独立视口中的同一窗口，不是同页同时打开。全部字段/按钮保持可读，窄屏自然换行，允许内部滚动，关闭和主动作可达。只画明确列出的窗口与文案，不加附注或父页导航。平面白/浅灰、深色字、细线、小圆角、#4566c6蓝色、清晰紧凑中文；不画设备外壳。只画现有“当前笔记查找”局部横向工具条，不造弹窗标题栏/保存按钮。桌面一条，390/320自然换行。按顺序：可见label“查找”和空input（焦点细蓝边）；计数“0 / 0”；“↑”“↓”两按钮灰色禁用；未勾checkbox“区分大小写”；可见label“替换”和空input可输入；按钮“替换当前”“全部替换”均灰色禁用；末尾关闭“×”可用。三个视口都保留顺序、全部字段和关闭，不加无结果提示、正文高亮或owner页面背景。

entry.trigger: Ctrl/Cmd+F or Ctrl/Cmd+H inside NoteEditorHost in either document/source mode; owner toolbar also exposes 查找替换

roles: guest holding currently editable public share
permissionRules: Canonical shared NoteEditorHost/EditorSearch visual for owner and public edit hosts. Owner API authorization is defined by owner host; guest is constrained to public share grant and public editor source. No owner toolbar/menu privilege is granted to guest.

Ctrl/Cmd+F/H withoutAlt and notIME composition opens search in both modes even without owner toolbar. Replace is blocked by props.readOnly or session.composing; guest host readOnly=busy||loading. Matching count must be nonzero.
PB-026/PB-027 own external editor page, public save/reload/expiry permissions and host context; this row owns shared find/replace widget.
